msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.colophon:
saṃvat 194
8 varṣe bhādrapadavadi 4 ravau likhiṃ pustakam idaṃ miśrakṛpa | rāmasya ||

supportDesc.foliation: Devanāgarī numerals, top-left and bottom-right margins, verso.

origin.origDate: Samvat 1948, Bhādrapada, interpreted as Vikrama era.

lg.l:
kathayaṃtaṃ hitīrthānāṃ pratāpā
nn adbhutās tathā ||
lomaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryapṛchat yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 1 ||
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |

tasya
puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 2 ||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagrāavaradakṣiṇāḥ ||

eka
to bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3 ||
idam eva purā devās tulayā samatolayan ||

prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gau
raveṇātiricyate || 4 ||
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||

iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca ||
5 ||
varttamānoe mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiver nṛpaṃ ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ || 6 ||

athomanaṃ
nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7 ||

tataḥ śyenaiḥ samā
gamya śyenarūpiaḥ sureśvaraḥ ||
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 8 ||

dharmātmānaṃ tu tvāṃ
prāhum ekaṃ rājamn mahīkṣitiaṃ ||
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃm etac cikīrṣasi || 9 ||

dharmabuddhe kathaṃ tu tvāṃ haṃsi
māṃ pīḍitaṃ kṣudhā ||
dharmabudhyā tvayā 'dharmaḥ kriyate sūkṣmabuddhinā || 10 ||

ko yaṃ dharmas tavedānīm ahaṃ vismaya
māyivān ||
asādhuḥ pālyate rājan_ sādhur vai hanyate tvayā ||

bhavoān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ
||
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇaṃm asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet || 12 ||
nopakārāpareṣv evoam upakāraparo janaḥ ||

nāpakāra
paro pīi tvāaṃ upakāraparo yathā || 12 ||
ahitoe hitabuddhis tvāaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt ||

doṣānveṣaṇadakṣoe pi guṇānveṣa
ṇatatparaḥ || 14 ||
sadaiva vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||
mā hiṃsir lobhato dharmaṃ dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asīi ||

adha
rmaṃ pālayat_ dharmaṃ māvadhīr iti me matiḥ ||
vidvadbhir garhitaṃ karma na rājan_ karttum arhasi || 16 ||

ekasya pālate hiṃsā ba
hūnāṃ tvaṃ na paśyasi
ahaṃ ca sahacāriṇyāṃ pitarau me stutās tathā || 17 ||

l.add: ādau rūpavināśanī kraśakarīkā yasya vidhvaṃsinī jñānaṃ maṃdakarītapakṣayakarī dharmasya nirmūlanī ||

putrabhrātrakalatrabhe
danakarī lajjākulachedanī sāmāṃ pīḍati sarvadoṣajananī prāṇāpahārī kṣudhā || 13 |

lg.l:
saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhī
to vihaṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptāaḥ prāṇagṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ || 18 ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayarttinaḥ ||

ka
tham asmadvidhāḥ kuryuḥ tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ || 19 ||
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃ ||

brahmahatyāsamaṃ ta
sya papam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 20 ||
śāstreṣu niḥṣkṛtiṃ dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||

śaraṇāgatahaṃtṛṇāṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛ
tiḥ kvacit || 21 ||
yathātmanaṃ priyaāḥ prāṇaāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||

tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ ||
22 ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte rit__yos traśyaṃti te tataḥ || 23 ||

yannimittaṃ bhave
chokas trāso vā duḥkham eva ca ||
āyāso vā yaśomūlam ekāṃmagam api ta tyajet || 24 ||

mariśyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyo
pajāyate ||
jñeyayuktaṃs tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ || 25 ||
yathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ | saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā ||
tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ || tenaiva vṛkṣena mukhaṃ hy ataṃ taṃ || 26 ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |

yad atra
yuktam manyaṃ te vaktum āśyenāasu tad vada || 27 ||
āhārāt sarvabhūtānāṃi saṃbhavaṃti janeśvarāa ||

āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃ
te tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 28 ||
śakyate na vinā tena cirarātrāya jīvituṃ ||

śakyate nair vinā py arthai rājan_ jīvayituṃ ciraṃ ||
29 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsmiān mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||
visṛjya kāyaāṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ || 30 ||

mṛte ca mayi sarve
me putradāraṃ mariṣyati ||
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotatvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi || 31 ||
dharme yo bādhyate dharmo na sa dharma sanātanaḥ ||

a
virodhena yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate || 32 ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ ||

yataḥ śreyas tato rājan_
kuru dharmavinirṇayaṃ || 33 ||
nāto bhūdharmāstat paro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecaraḥ ||

prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ ma
ma bhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 34 ||
varam ekasya satvasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā ||
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ sa kāṃcanaṃ || 35 ||

a
bhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ vidate kvacit || 36 ||

hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ
sulabhā bhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtabhayapradaḥ || 37 ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||

bhītābha
yapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 38 ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ taghāpūrttaṃ tīrthāasevā śrutaṃ tathā ||

sarvaāṇy abhayadānasya phalāṃ nārhaṃti
ṣoḍaśīṃ || 39 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtaṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyos tayor abhayado 'dhikaḥ || 40 ||

api
tyajed rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajāaṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyakṣe diīnaṃ kapotakaṃ || 41 ||

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani
janmani ||
bhaveyam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśānaṃ || 42 ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ ||

prāṇināṃ duḥ
khataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ || 43 ||
yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛtā ||

tena satyena bhagavān_ prasīdatu ma
heśvaraḥ || 44 ||
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāryaṃ vihaṃgamaḥ ||
yad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyad eva dadāmy ahaṃ || 45 ||
sa eva vihito bhakṣo dhātrāsmākaṃ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evotsṛja nāhāraiḥ kāryaṃ me nyair nnareṣvara || 46 ||

śyenāḥ kapotā
n khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āruha || 47 ||

nāhaṃ kuśāstramā
rgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama ||
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmasatyadayāparaḥ || 48 ||

sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā da
yā ||
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikāsmin viśiṣyate || 49 ||
sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara ||

sarvatīrthābhi
ṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 50 ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiś caiva sarvabhūtahite ratā ||

dayādarśitiapaṃthāno brahmalo
kaṃ vrajaṃti te || 51 ||
gachatās tiṣṭhator vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ || 52 ||

jaṃ
gamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāni ca ye narāḥ ||
ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 53 ||

prāṇinaāṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu
yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃm iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 54 ||

rājyaṃ samastaṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvi
ja ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ || 55 ||
yadi rājan_ kapotena sudṛḍhā prītir uttmaā ||

tataḥ ka
potatulyāni svamāṃsāni dadasva me || 56 ||
anugrahāam imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||

tat te haṃ saṃpradāvaśyāmi svamāṃ
saṃ yāvad ichasi || 57 ||
yad aprit priyaṃ tat tu sujanaś cirād vadati vā na vā ||
mama tu priyam evaitat kasmaādāaabhihitaṃ cirāt || 58 ||
adhruvena śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārjjayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ || 59 ||

yadi prāṇyupa
kārāya doeho yaṃ nopayujyate ||
tataḥ kim upacāro sya kriyate pratyahaṃ vṛthā || 60 ||

nātirisamadhiktam ahaṃ yāce tava
māṃsaṃ nareśvara ||
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtaṃ || 61 ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||
yenaāsya maraṇaṃ na syāt tadvat tava vihaṃgamāa || 62 ||
evam uktvā svamīṃsāni samutkṛtya svapārthivaḥ ||

prahṛ
ṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabho || 63 ||
tyaktvātmāasukhabhogechāḥ sarvasatvahitaiṣiṇāṃaḥ ||

bhavaṃti paraduḥ
khena sādhavo tyaṃtaduḥkhitāḥ || 64 ||
dhriyamāne tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate ||

l.add:
punaś cotkṛtya
māṃsāni rājann ādāt sa pārthivaḥ

na vidyate ya
dā māṃsaṃ ka
potena samaṃ
kvacit

lg.l:
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso 'sāv āruro
ha tulā svayaṃ || 65 ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nāpekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api || 66 ||
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||

l.add:
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmarājño dhṛtiṃ
parāṃ

lg.l: śākraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata || 67 ||

iṃdro ha
m asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ ||
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāsthitau || 68 ||

naitat pūrvaṃ nṛpāś cakrur na
kariṣyaṃty athāpare ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tvayā || 69 ||

parārthaṃ tyajataḥ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tava
||
prāṇasaṃśayalabdhena na prāṇeṣu ca dehināṃ || 70 ||
parārthaikāṃtakalyāṇī svāśrayātyaṃtaniṣṭhurā ||

tvayaiva keva
laṃ rājan_ karuṇākaruṇāyate || 71 ||
svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair vaddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||

tvaṃ jagat_ duḥkhamokṣārthaṃ vaddhaḥ
karuṇaya nṛpa || 72 ||
tathā sarvātmanā cāpi doṣeṣu prahṛtaṃ tvayā ||

tathā caivātmana sthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate ||
73 ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ lokān uttamatāṃ gataḥ || 74 ||

l.add: sajalā jaladās tvaṃ ca saphalāṃ sa mahādrumāḥ || 76 ||

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo rakṣati
naraḥ sadā ||
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvarttate punaḥ || 77 ||

paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalā
tmodaraṃbharāḥ ||

punar jīvati sa ślāghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ hi jī
vati || 79 ||
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||

na hi svadeha
śaityāya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ || 80 ||

lg.l:
paropakā
ravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā
sapadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ ||
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gatanispṛhāḥ
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||
yat svamāṃsāni bhūtebhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pārthiva ||

eṣā te śāśva
tī kīrttir lokān anugamiṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā cirān mahīṃ ||

sarvān_ lokān atikramya bra
hmalokaṃ gamiṣyati ||
evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ ||

rājā tu kratum iṣṭvā
tu mumude devavac ciraṃ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ ||

sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ ta
taḥ ||
viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaś ca sarvasya janasya durlabhaṃ

svajīvadānāt parijīvarakṣaṇaṃ
vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau ||
